solves.reason: (A) 'a unique culture has developed'=독특한 문화 → unique / (B) 'rank stores by various standards'=다양한 기준 → various / (C) 'delivery of purchased items'=구매한 물품 → purchased
(A) 'Delivery mistakes were rare'=배달 실수는 드물었다 → rare / (B) 'unfailingly honest and accurate'=정직 → honest / (C) 'Customers trusted the messengers'=신뢰했다 → trusted
(A) 'keeping prices reasonable'=합리적 가격 → reasonable / (B) 'phenomenal growth of e-commerce'=경이로운 성장 → phenomenal / (C) 'choose a specific date'=특정 날짜 → specific
③refusing='delivering food'이어야 문맥 성립(한국인이 배달해온 역사). refusing(거절)은 반대 → 부적절
④careless='honest and accurate(정확한)'와 병렬이어야 함. 신뢰받는 메신저가 careless(부주의)는 모순 → 부적절
②declined='grew again thanks to urbanization'(도시화로 다시 성장)이어야 함. declined(쇠퇴)는 반대 → 부적절
'Deliveries of newspapers and milk quickly became ___'=신문·우유 배달이 널리 퍼짐 → popular. illegal/expensive/temporary 문맥 불일치
'delivered by name and place of ___'=이름과 거주지 → residence. jeonin이 지역을 훤히 알아야 했던 맥락과 부합
'taekbae service ... was ___. On the first day, there were just two deliveries'=1992년 도입 → introduced. banned/canceled/delayed 불일치
flocked(떼지어 몰려들다)=도시로 몰려듦 → rushed
maintain(유지하다)='유지' → keep
testing(시도/시험하다)='가능성을 시도' → trying
divided(나뉘다)의 반의어 → united
rapid(빠른)의 반의어 → slow (swift=동의어 함정)
(A) charged with the safety=책임을 맡기다 / (B) charged fifty dollars=청구하다 → 맡기다-청구하다
'편지/소포/메시지를 나르는 사람' → messenger
trays full of food ___ (stack) on top of each other=쌓인 → 과거분사 stacked
It was ... technology that ___ (enable) the growth=가능하게 했다 → 과거형 enabled
'rule of thumb for taekbae is ___; order today, arrive tomorrow'=익일 배송 → next-day delivery
'have grown by ___ thanks to advancements'=비약적으로 성장 → leaps and bounds(관용구)
